developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for playing Prenecrotic and sharing your experience with us! We're really happy to hear that the atmosphere made such a strong impression on you.

We've actually been working on updating the environment to make it feel even more realistic and immersive. You'll be getting to experience these improvements in an upcoming update soon, and we believe it will make the horror experience even more intense! 👻

We genuinely value player feedback and pay close attention to your suggestions. Our goal is to keep improving both the demo and the full game so we can deliver the best possible experience to our players.

And your comment about that couch dialogue made us smile! 😂 We appreciate you pointing it out, and we'll keep your feedback about the voice acting in mind as well.

We hope you'll return to the school when you're ready for another terrifying experience! Thank you again for your support. It truly means a lot to us! ❤️

reviews.review_title: Love it so far, a few frustrations
reviews.review_description: I really enjoyed my experience playing this Demo, in fact, it's got me excited to play the full game. I felt intrigued and pulled into the story. The atmosphere keeps you on edge. I did have an issue not with the backpack, but with grabbing the crow-bar. The first time, before the cut-scene, I had it in my hand, it disappeared. The next attempt, I left it on the floor, it disappeared. Finally, I saw the prompt to "grab from your right shoulder", I still couldn't grab it. Eventually, after multiple attempts, I was able to grab it, but I had to stretch an un-natural amount to get it, (also, I'm very flexible already so that's saying something) so I think this mechanic needs a little adjusting. Also, some of the voice acting (AI) is worse than others. I'd genuinely be happy to lend my voice to the game for free for a female character. :)  I also know other VR content creators who would probably also gladly contribute. I sent an email, but feel free to reach out to me.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for playing our demo! 🥰❤️ We're really happy you enjoyed the story and atmosphere! 👻 We'll update the demo and do our best to fix the crowbar issue and other problems you've experienced. 🔧 We're also improving the graphics to create an even more immersive and terrifying horror atmosphere! 🌫️🩸 We'll work on improving the voice acting as well. 🎙️ Your feedback really helps us improve the demo, and we'll do our very best to deliver a great experience in the full game! ❤️ We've noted your email and will reach out! 😊🙏 Thank you for your support! 💖🎮

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for playing the demo twice and for taking the time to share such detailed feedback! ❤️ We’re really glad to hear that you enjoyed the gameplay and had a great time with the demo.

We’re sorry you experienced the freezing and massive frame drops. We’ll investigate why this happened and work on identifying the cause. We’ll do our best to fix these performance issues in a future update.

Your feedback is really helpful to us, and we truly appreciate your support and kind words. Thank you again for playing and for giving our game another try! ❤️

reviews.review_title: 👻 Chilling VR Horror with Claws & Perso
reviews.review_description:
Prenecrotic: The Cursed School nails classic survival horror—detailed maps, eerie lighting, a gripping story, and satisfying shooting mechanics—all wrapped in top-tier assets and NPCs that make the dread feel palpable. It borrows from Resident Evil but forges its own terrifying identity, pulling you deeper into the mystery with every step.
The demo doesn’t just show horror—it immerses you in it, with sound design and encounters that haunt you long after. If the full game delivers this level of immersive terror, it’s a must-play for horror fans. Now we just need the full release!

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the amazing and detailed feedback! ❤️ We’re really glad you enjoyed the atmosphere, story, sound design, and overall VR horror experience.

We’ll put in our absolute best effort to make sure the full release lives up to your expectations and that everyone enjoys it even more. 🙏🔥

Thank you for supporting

reviews.review_description:
The graphics are primitive. It reminds me of the way some indie horror games looked on the Oculus Go, only it's in 6DOF. Despite that the performance is very poor with frequent stuttering and hitching. I don't know how something this dated looking can run this poorly on the Quest 3.

The character animations are truly horrid. They move like robots, and not the sophisticated humanoid robots we have now, they move like a clunky metal humanoid robot from a 1950's sci-fi movie.

The voice overs sound extremely bad, possibly the worst voice acting I've ever heard in a video game. The AIs who read these lines should be ashamed.

I have no idea why people are giving this 4 and 5 star reviews, but to each their own.

Taking this one off my wishlist

developer_response.body:
We’re really sorry that you experienced these issues, and we appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback.

We’re currently in Early Access and actively upgrading the demo. We’ve noted the issues you mentioned and will do our best to address and improve them in upcoming updates.

Thank you again for trying the game.
